scope: Union computed from captured original composition mesh AABB and pose values clipped to a 32 x 32 m XZ window around each matched view target. Includes vertical projection and all retained roots, even hidden/offscreen ones. This is an upper bound on possible local plant coverage, not measured leaf opacity, visible-screen density, terrain area or reference-image segmentation. R7 remains inside these envelopes, including sway. No geometry is generated by this measurement.

proposal_only.option_a: Review this bounded candidate at retained envelopes; accept that its ground cannot form the reference continuous understorey.
proposal_only.option_b: Separately authorize a 2x horizontal/vertical render-envelope study at the same root poses: tuft 0.300 x 0.158 x 0.296 m to at most 0.600 x 0.317 x 0.592 m; ground fern 0.520 x 0.246 x 0.389 m to at most 1.040 x 0.492 x 0.778 m. Individual XZ envelope area increases at most fourfold before overlap; terrain fit, source sightlines, actual controller clearance and building/excavation masking must be re-evaluated. This is not implemented or accepted.
proposal_only.option_c: If more roots or continuous terrain dressing is selected instead, commission a separate geography/save-compatibility decision and source-surface fitting work. No new anchors, scatter or topology are present in R7.
